_comment: Demo overrides for the race catalog. `human` matches an id in default/races.json so it overrides the canonical record (note the new description). `tiefling` is a new id so it's added to the merged list. All other races (dwarf, elf, halfling, gnome, ...) inherit from default unchanged.

races.name: Tiefling
races.description: Touched by infernal heritage — bears a faint heat-shimmer in dim light and is unsettled by holy ground.
